title: The growing popularity of cycling
paragraphs: They say once you learn how to ride a bike, you never forget. Most of us learnt when we were kids, and many still strap on our helmets, put our feet on the pedals, and shoot off for a ride around the streets. In recent times, cycling has seen a boost in popularity, so the question is, what makes it so appealing to people to straddle their bikes once again?

First, let’s look at the health benefits. Cycling can improve your cardiovascular health and burn excess body fat. Strengthening your leg muscles in your calves and thighs helps to increase your potential torque and cadence. And cycling’s benefits aren’t just physical, but mental as well. A long ride in the countryside could help you to clear your mind, or de-stress. But it’s not only about your body and mind – there are also some plus sides for your wallet’s health.

Cycling can be a great way to commute or get about town. By cycling, you save money on fuel or train fares. If you do drive into work, sometimes finding somewhere to park can be a nightmare, whereas finding somewhere to chain your bike up can be much simpler. Then, on the train, there are changes at stations and other commuters speaking loudly on their phones to deal with. Cyclists face neither of these issues. And if you’re worried about safety, there are designated cycle lanes in many major cities. Wearing high-visibility clothing, sometimes referred to as ‘hi-vis’, is another way to improve your safety when cycling on the roads.
Finally, cycling can also be good for the environment. It can help you to reduce your carbon footprint. Not pumping out fumes into the atmosphere is better for the planet and your own environment.
So, whether people want to cycle for their health, getting about town, their wallet, the environment, or a combination of all of them – the popularity of cycling is on the rise.

vocabulary.entry: cycling /ˈsaɪklɪŋ/ n. 骑行；自行车运动
vocabulary.example: Cycling is a cheap and healthy way to get around.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行是一种既经济又健康的出行方式。

vocabulary.example: You should wear a helmet whenever you go cycling.
vocabulary.translation: 每次骑行都应该戴上头盔。

vocabulary.example: She pushed hard on the pedal to climb the hill.
vocabulary.translation: 她用力蹬脚踏板爬坡。

vocabulary.example: Regular exercise is good for cardiovascular health.
vocabulary.translation: 规律运动有益心血管健康。

vocabulary.example: The long ride made her calf muscles ache.
vocabulary.translation: 长途骑行让她的小腿肌肉酸痛。

vocabulary.example: Cycling is an effective way to tone your thigh muscles.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行是锻炼大腿肌肉的有效方式。

vocabulary.example: Higher torque allows the bike to accelerate more quickly.
vocabulary.translation: 更大的扭矩能让自行车加速更快。

vocabulary.example: Maintaining a steady cadence is key to efficient cycling.
vocabulary.translation: 保持稳定的踏频是高效骑行的关键。

vocabulary.entry: commute /kəˈmjuːt/ n. 通勤；上下班路程
vocabulary.example: I go to work by bike – it’s a short commute.
vocabulary.translation: 我骑自行车上班，通勤路程很短。

vocabulary.example: Rising fuel prices have made cycling more popular.
vocabulary.translation: 燃油价格上涨让骑行变得更受欢迎。

vocabulary.example: The train fare to the city centre is quite expensive.
vocabulary.translation: 去市中心的火车票很贵。

vocabulary.example: Finding parking in the city centre is always difficult.
vocabulary.translation: 在市中心找停车位总是很难。

vocabulary.example: Don’t forget to chain your bike to the rail.
vocabulary.translation: 别忘了把自行车用链条锁在栏杆上。

vocabulary.entry: cycle lane /ˈsaɪkl leɪn/ n. 自行车道
vocabulary.example: The new cycle lane makes cycling to work safer.
vocabulary.translation: 新的自行车道让骑车上班变得更安全。

vocabulary.entry: high-visibility clothing /ˌhaɪ ˌvɪzəˈbɪləti ˈkləʊðɪŋ/ n. 高能见度服装
vocabulary.example: Wearing high-visibility clothing is essential for night cycling.
vocabulary.translation: 夜间骑行必须穿高能见度服装。

vocabulary.entry: carbon footprint /ˈkɑːbən ˈfʊtprɪnt/ n. 碳足迹
vocabulary.example: Cycling helps to reduce your carbon footprint.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行有助于减少碳足迹。

vocabulary.example: Car fumes are harmful to the environment.
vocabulary.translation: 汽车尾气对环境有害。

vocabulary.example: Pollutants are released into the atmosphere every day.
vocabulary.translation: 污染物每天都被排放到大气中。

vocabulary.example: There has been a boost in cycling since the new lanes opened.
vocabulary.translation: 新车道开通后，骑行人数大幅增加。

vocabulary.entry: appealing /əˈpiːlɪŋ/ adj. 有吸引力的；诱人的
vocabulary.example: Cycling is an appealing alternative to driving.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行是一种很有吸引力的驾车替代方式。

vocabulary.example: He straddled his bike and set off down the road.
vocabulary.translation: 他跨上自行车，沿着马路骑走了。

vocabulary.entry: excess /ɪkˈses/ adj. 多余的；过量的
vocabulary.example: Cycling is a good way to burn excess fat.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行是燃烧多余脂肪的好方法。

vocabulary.entry: plus side /ˈplʌs saɪd/ n. 好处；优势
vocabulary.example: The plus side of cycling is that it saves you money.
vocabulary.translation: 骑行的好处是能帮你省钱。

vocabulary.entry: designated /ˈdezɪɡneɪtɪd/ adj. 指定的；专用的
vocabulary.example: This is a designated area for bicycle parking.
vocabulary.translation: 这是指定的自行车停放区。

vocabulary.entry: popularity /ˌpɒpjuˈlærəti/ n. 流行；受欢迎程度
vocabulary.example: The popularity of cycling has grown rapidly in recent years.
vocabulary.translation: 近年来骑行的受欢迎程度迅速攀升。

sentences.chinese: 我们大多数人都是小时候学会骑车的，现在还有不少人会戴上头盔，蹬上脚踏板，骑着车在街道上疾驰。

sentences.english: In recent times, cycling has seen a boost in popularity, so the question is, what makes it so appealing to people to straddle their bikes once again?
sentences.chinese: 近年来，骑行的受欢迎程度大幅提升，那么问题来了，是什么让人们再次热衷于骑上自行车呢？

sentences.english: First, let’s look at the health benefits.
sentences.chinese: 首先我们来看看骑行对健康的益处。

sentences.english: Cycling can improve your cardiovascular health and burn excess body fat.
sentences.chinese: 骑行能够改善心血管健康，燃烧体内多余脂肪。

sentences.english: Strengthening your leg muscles in your calves and thighs helps to increase your potential torque and cadence.
sentences.chinese: 强化小腿和大腿部位的腿部肌肉，有助于提升骑行扭矩和踏频的潜力。

sentences.english: And cycling’s benefits aren’t just physical, but mental as well.
sentences.chinese: 而且骑行带来的好处不止体现在身体上，对心理健康也大有裨益。

sentences.english: A long ride in the countryside could help you to clear your mind, or de-stress.
sentences.chinese: 在乡间长途骑行，可以帮助你理清思绪、释放压力。

sentences.english: But it’s not only about your body and mind – there are also some plus sides for your wallet’s health.
sentences.chinese: 但骑行的好处可不止于身心层面，对钱包来说也是一大福音。

sentences.english: Cycling can be a great way to commute or get about town.
sentences.chinese: 骑行是通勤或在市区出行的绝佳方式。

sentences.english: By cycling, you save money on fuel or train fares.
sentences.chinese: 骑车出行可以省下燃油费或火车票钱。

sentences.english: If you do drive into work, sometimes finding somewhere to park can be a nightmare, whereas finding somewhere to chain your bike up can be much simpler.
sentences.chinese: 如果开车上班，有时候找停车位会是一场噩梦，而找地方锁自行车则要简单得多。

sentences.english: Then, on the train, there are changes at stations and other commuters speaking loudly on their phones to deal with.
sentences.chinese: 坐火车的话，还得应对换乘以及其他通勤者大声打电话的干扰。

sentences.english: Cyclists face neither of these issues.
sentences.chinese: 骑行者则不会遇到这两种麻烦。

sentences.english: And if you’re worried about safety, there are designated cycle lanes in many major cities.
sentences.chinese: 如果你担心安全问题，许多大城市都设有专用自行车道。

sentences.english: Wearing high-visibility clothing, sometimes referred to as ‘hi-vis’, is another way to improve your safety when cycling on the roads.
sentences.chinese: 穿上高能见度服装（有时被称为“反光服”），也是提升道路骑行安全性的另一种方法。

sentences.english: Finally, cycling can also be good for the environment.
sentences.chinese: 最后，骑行对环境也有益处。

sentences.english: It can help you to reduce your carbon footprint.
sentences.chinese: 它能帮助你减少碳足迹。

sentences.english: Not pumping out fumes into the atmosphere is better for the planet and your own environment.
sentences.chinese: 不会向大气中排放尾气，无论是对地球还是对周边环境来说，都是一件好事。

sentences.english: So, whether people want to cycle for their health, getting about town, their wallet, the environment, or a combination of all of them – the popularity of cycling is on the rise.
sentences.chinese: 所以，无论人们是为了健康、出行、省钱、环保，还是兼而有之，骑行的热度都在持续攀升。
